snippet.title: The Zyrdain Sands // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4235200/The_Zyrdain_Sands

Welcome to CO-OPPOSED gameplay. Shoot, evolve, and survive in this visceral Twin Stick Shooter while Demon Gods constantly sabotage your run with no-shots, sandstorms, and cursed upgrades as you evolve Zyrd's weapons to save the Sacred Stone.

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: FifoArts
📚 Publisher: fknE, FIGU ltda
📅 Release Date: To be announced
🎯 Genre: Action, Indie

AI Generated Content Disclosure
The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:
This game subtly experiments with AI-assisted tools in parts of the experience and in some of the marketing images.

Mature Content Description
The developers describe the content like this:
It's a visceral, gore-soaked pixel art game where you kill demons as blood splashes everywhere.
